## 1. What we are building

A deployable, single-user demo for buying and selling 24K gold in PKR using live market data. git clone https://github.com/samiemirza/asasa-assessment.git

|---|---|

# Export the full Claude Code transcript(s) for this project into logs/transcripts/ (redacted JSONL + readable Markdown).

OUT="$ROOT/logs/transcripts"

files=("$SRC"/*.jsonl)
